title: Release with a per-pack list of added and changed cases
goal: Release with a per-pack list of added and changed cases
acceptance: CHANGELOG lists added, changed and removed cases per pack, so a consumer sees what will be pending

The release title names what changes in the published package (for example "0.8.0 — incremental runs"), never the development-harness version; harness-only updates are not released (owner, 2026-11-13)
privacy: Neutral invented cases and fixtures only; no consumer data, private reports or credentials in Git.
escalation: No knowledge of any consumer; a consumer-specific need goes to that consumer's backlog
Material scope or effort growth goes to the owner before adoption

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-13 at the harness 8.5.0 initial size for a scoped single-PR agent step (0.25–0.5 h); first plan said 1–2 h. Not a measurement.
